offering_description.value: BellRing Brands sells ready-to-drink protein shakes and protein powders for everyday nutrition and sports performance. It develops and markets the products, uses third-party manufacturers, and sells through retailers and distributors.

primary_products.value: ready-to-drink protein shakes; protein powders; mass-gainer powders

customer_segment.value: B2B: warehouse clubs, mass merchants, grocers, online retailers, specialty nutrition retailers and distributors; B2C: consumers seeking convenient protein, athletes and fitness enthusiasts

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged protein shakes and nutrition powders sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops protein nutrition products, contracts out manufacturing and sells finished goods to retailers and distributors

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States, with sales in Canada and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: ready-to-drink protein beverages and powdered sports nutrition

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: warehouse clubs, mass merchants, grocery stores, drugstores and specialty nutrition shops; online: online marketplaces and retailer websites; direct sales: sales to major retail accounts; distributors / dealers: nutrition distributors serving specialty retailers and international markets
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; online; direct sales; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food and dietary supplement rules on manufacturing, labeling and product claims

notes: The full current list of international markets is uncertain.
